description: ZUJPOM crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C104 H68 Dy4 F12 N8 O22 S4,4(C1 H4 O1). From the CIF bond table, Dy1 (Dy) has 6 O neighbors; Dy2 (Dy) has 6 O neighbors; Dy1A (Dy) has 6 O neighbors; Dy2A (Dy) has 6 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 2 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.807-3.807 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 106.77-106.83°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C108H84Dy4F12N8O26S4 ([Dy4(TTA)4L4(H2O)2]·4CH3OH; unsolvated core C104H68Dy4F12N8O22S4). Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 2 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 2 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)). Article name explicitly identifies S(I).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
